hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

hangar.tenancy.v1alpha1.Limits.description: Limits caps what a tenant, or one of its projects, may hold. Where Limits is set says what an unset field means. cpu and memory count only machines asked to run; a stopped machine still counts its disk and its place among machines.

cpu.description: vCPUs, a quantity in Kubernetes syntax, such as "8" or "2500m".

customImages.description: CustomImages; one that failed counts toward no limit.

disk.description: Disk space, a quantity such as "200Gi": containers' disks, Disks, the root disks VMs have made from images, FileShares, and CustomImages, each at its source disk's size while it is captured and at what it holds once Ready.

domains.description: CustomDomains of the tenant. Only a Plan sets it.

fileShares.description: FileShares. A share's server is the platform's, and counts toward no limit.

machineCalls.description: Calls to machines' nodes the tenant's callers may keep open at once, together, and each caller alone: each log read or follow, exec, ssh, console or port-forward session, and each chunk of a CustomImage's upload, from its start to its end. A call over it fails at once with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, and a change applies from the next call. Only a Plan sets it, from 1 to 512; unset, it is 64. Usage does not count it. See docs/decisions/node-tunnel.md.

networkEndpoints.description: NetworkEndpoints, each holding an address of its network.

networks.description: Networks, each project's default network among them.

portForwards.description: PortForwards, each holding a port of the shared IPv4 address.

projects.description: Projects of the tenant. Only a Plan sets it.

hangar.tenancy.v1alpha1.TenantSpec.description: TenantSpec is the desired state of a tenant.

plan.description: Name of the Plan that sets this tenant's quota limits; empty means the platform default. An apply that leaves it empty keeps the stored plan; naming "default" moves the tenant back to the default, stored as empty.

hangar.tenancy.v1alpha1.TenantStatus.description: TenantStatus is the observed state of a tenant.

limits.description: The plan's limits; an unset field has no limit, but for machine_calls, which is then 64.

plan.description: The Plan the tenant has: spec.plan, or "default".

usage.description: What all the tenant's projects hold.

hangar.tenancy.v1alpha1.Usage.description: Usage is what a tenant, or one of its projects, holds, counted as Limits counts it.

description: Tenant is who: the people and identities that own projects. Membership is expressed with RoleBindings scoped to the tenant.
title: Tenant
